paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tzor.

In [Ketubot 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.7a.11), Rabbi Abbahu recounts that Rabbi Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tzor asked Rabbi Yohanan in Tzaidan. In [Berakhot 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.33a.31), the questioner is Rabbi Yose (Hyman proposes Assi), or, according to another version, Rabbi Shimon ben Yaakov of Tzor. He asked Rabbi Yohanan [in Tzaidan, Dikdukei Soferim]. It is very plausible to say that in both places the reading should be either Rabbi Yishmael or Rabbi Shimon.

notes.text: The checked passages retain Yishmael in Ketubot and Yose or Shimon in Berakhot. Hyman’s corrections to Assi and to one common name remain his proposals.

The questions differ: [Ketubot 7a:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.7a.11) concerns the first marital intercourse on Shabbat, and [Berakhot 33a:31](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.33a.31) concerns Havdalah.
